image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a dark-colored computer keyboard. The focus is on the bottom row, specifically highlighting a large, elongated key in the center which appears to be the space bar, flanked by modifier keys (likely Alt/Option and Command/Ctrl). Above it are rows of standard letter keys. The lighting creates reflections on the matte plastic surfaces.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The space bar is physically split into two separate segments with a visible gap in the middle. A functional space bar must be a single continuous unit to actuate the switch. This is a major structural failure.

artifact_observations.location: Symbols on the space bar and adjacent keys
artifact_observations.reasoning: The white markings on the space bar are nonsensical symbols that do not correspond to any standard keyboard legend. The text on the adjacent modifier keys is also blurry and illegible, resembling AI-generated pseudo-text.
The gaps between keys are inconsistent, and the perspective warping of the upper rows feels slightly unnatural, suggesting minor geometric instability.
